generic.Defined scope/population: The single broker indication request being answered on the CRM broker opportunity record
generic.In-scope period: From indication approval through to the stated indication validity date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium low/high band, validity date, caveat line and submission requirement list all present
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Premium range in the outgoing message matches the range held on the CRM indication record
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sent indication document attached to the opportunity with send timestamp and version number
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications sent without a caveat or validity date are logged and dispositioned by reissue
generic.Test population: All indications issued to brokers through the Broker and Agent Portal in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued indication shows a range, the indication only caveat and a validity date
generic.Exception handling path: A missing caveat or validity date is withdrawn and reissued the same business day
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indication is a range, carries the not a quote caveat and lists full submission requirements
generic.Evidence location: Outbound activity on the CRM broker opportunity with the indication document attached

steps.title: Open the broker opportunity record in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics)
sop: Search CRM by broker name and insured to locate the indication opportunity
Confirm the opportunity is the one the indication request was logged against
Check the underwriter of record and owning desk are populated
Done when the correct CRM opportunity is open and confirmed as the indication record
verify: Opportunity reference matches the indication request reference
Pass when the open CRM record is the indication opportunity for this insured and broker

steps.title: Retrieve the approved indicative premium range from the indication record
sop: Read the low and high premium band recorded against the approved rating run
Confirm the range was taken from the rating tool output and not typed by hand
Confirm the minimum premium for the line sits at or below the low end
Done when the approved low/high band is confirmed for use in the message
verify: Band on the record matches the referenced rating run output
Pass when the range quoted onward equals the recorded approved band

steps.title: Draft the indication message in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics) as a range
sop: State the premium as a low to high range, never as a single firm number
State the basis of the range including class, limits and exposure assumed
Avoid any wording that could read as a bindable offer
Done when the draft states the premium only as a range
verify: Draft body contains no single firm premium figure
Pass when the only premium expressed is the approved low to high range

steps.title: Insert the indication only caveat and validity date into the draft
sop: Paste the standard indication only, not a quote caveat paragraph verbatim
Enter the indication validity date in the body of the message
State that a formal quote requires a full submission and formal underwriting
Done when caveat and validity date both appear in the message body
verify: Caveat text matches the approved standard wording
Pass when both the caveat line and a dated validity statement are present

steps.title: List the full submission requirements that convert the indication to a quote
sop: List the completed proposal form, schedule of values and exposure data required
List the loss experience years required and any survey or questionnaire needed
State that the indication cannot be firmed up until the listed items are received
Done when the message carries a complete submission requirement list
verify: Requirement list covers proposal, exposure data and loss experience
Pass when a broker could act on the list without further clarification

steps.title: Send the indication through the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Upload the indication document to the broker portal against the account
Send from the portal or shared underwriting mailbox, never a personal mailbox
Confirm the broker recipient is the named producer on the request
Done when the indication is visible to the broker in the portal
verify: Portal shows the indication document delivered to the named producer
Pass when the send originates from the portal or shared mailbox, not a personal one

steps.title: Log the outbound indication activity against the CRM opportunity
sop: Create an outbound activity on the CRM opportunity with the send date and time
Attach the issued indication document to the activity
Record the premium range and validity date on the opportunity fields
Done when the activity and attachment exist on the opportunity record
verify: Activity timestamp matches the portal delivery time
Pass when the logged activity carries the issued indication document as an attachment

generic.Defined scope/population: The indication record in the underwriting workstation for this insured and broker request
generic.In-scope period: From indication creation until the stated non-binding validity period expires
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status flag Non-binding and the indication expiry date are both populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validity period on the record equals the validity period stated in the outgoing document
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication document version carrying the caveat stored against the record with its date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any indication left bindable or undated is logged and corrected before release
generic.Test population: All indication records created in the underwriting workstation in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every indication record shows status Non-binding with a populated expiry date
generic.Exception handling path: A bindable effective date found on an indication is removed and the record re-flagged
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Non-binding status, stated expiry and the caveat present in the document itself
generic.Evidence location: Indication record status and expiry fields in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Open the indication record in the underwriting workstation
sop: Locate the indication record by broker account and insured name
Confirm the record type is Indication and not a full submission
Confirm the record is linked to the correct broker opportunity
Done when the correct indication record is open
verify: Record type field reads Indication
Pass when the open record is the indication for this insured and broker

steps.title: Set the workstation status field to Non-binding
sop: Select Non-binding from the controlled status list on the indication record
Save the record and confirm the status persists after save
Confirm no downstream binding workflow has been triggered
Done when the record status reads Non-binding
verify: Status field displays Non-binding after save
Pass when the saved record status is Non-binding

steps.title: Enter the stated validity period in the indication expiry field
sop: Calculate the expiry date from the issue date using the standard validity period
Enter the expiry date into the indication expiry field
Confirm the expiry date is not later than the maximum allowed validity for the line
Done when a valid expiry date is stored on the record
verify: Expiry date is populated and within the allowed validity window
Pass when expiry date equals issue date plus the stated validity period

steps.title: Clear any bindable coverage effective date on the indication record
sop: Check the coverage effective date field on the indication record
Remove any effective date that would allow the indication to be bound
Confirm no policy shell has been created in the policy administration system
Done when the indication carries no bindable effective date
verify: Coverage effective date field is empty on the indication record
Pass when no bindable effective date or policy shell exists for the indication

steps.title: Insert the standard non-binding caveat verbatim into the indication document
sop: Paste the approved non-binding caveat paragraph into the indication document body
Compare the pasted text word for word against the approved standard wording
Repeat the caveat in the covering message as well as the document
Done when the caveat appears verbatim in the document itself
verify: Caveat wording in the document matches the approved paragraph exactly
Pass when the caveat appears in the document and not only in the covering email

steps.title: Record the caveat confirmation on the record in the policy administration system
sop: Open the matching account record in the policy administration system
Note that the indication is non-binding with its expiry date on the account note
Attach the caveated indication document version to the account
Done when the non-binding note and document are stored against the account
verify: Account note states non-binding status and expiry date
Pass when the caveated document version is attached and dated on the account

generic.Defined scope/population: The risk data supplied by the broker for this indication request across all rated sections

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal name, address, industry class, limits, deductibles and exposure basis all captured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exposure values captured equal the totals on the broker supplied schedule

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every request shows a recorded sufficient or insufficient decision with no blank fields
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient data is returned to the broker with a named list of missing items
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All mandatory fields captured or an explicit gap note recorded against each one
generic.Evidence location: Data sufficiency section of the indication record in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Download the broker submitted data pack from the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Open the indication request in the broker portal and list the attached documents
Download the proposal, schedule of values and any loss run provided
Attach the downloaded pack to the indication record in the workstation
Done when the full broker data pack is stored on the indication record
verify: Every document listed in the portal is present on the indication record
Pass when portal attachment count equals the count stored on the record

steps.title: Capture insured legal name, trading address and industry class in the workstation
sop: Enter the insured legal name exactly as stated on the proposal
Enter the trading address for each location supplied
Select the industry or SIC class code from the controlled list
Done when name, address and class code are stored on the indication record
verify: Legal name and address match the broker proposal document
Pass when name, address and a valid class code are all populated

steps.title: Record requested limits, deductibles and coverage basis per section
sop: List each coverage section the broker has requested
Enter the requested limit, sub-limit and deductible for each section
Record the coverage basis such as occurrence or claims made per section
Done when every requested section carries limit, deductible and basis
verify: Section count on the record equals the sections requested by the broker
Pass when no requested section is missing a limit, deductible or basis

steps.title: Enter the exposure basis for each rated section in the workstation
sop: Identify the rating exposure basis required for each section
Enter TIV, payroll, turnover or fleet count as applicable per section
Reconcile the entered totals to the broker schedule of values
Done when each rated section carries a populated exposure value
verify: Entered exposure totals reconcile to the broker schedule totals
Pass when no rated section is left without an exposure basis value

steps.title: Assess loss experience coverage for the last three years
sop: Check whether loss runs are supplied for each of the last three years
Record claim counts and incurred amounts per year where supplied
Where a year is missing, record it as explicitly unavailable with the broker reason
Done when each of the three years is either populated or noted as unavailable
verify: Three loss years are each marked supplied or explicitly unavailable
Pass when no loss year is left silently blank

steps.title: Record the data sufficiency decision on the indication record
sop: Review the captured field set against the mandatory data checklist
Select sufficient or insufficient on the indication record
Where insufficient, list the specific missing items in the gap note
Done when the sufficiency decision and any gap note are saved
verify: Decision field is populated with sufficient or insufficient
Pass when an insufficient decision carries a named list of missing items

steps.title: Return the gap list to the broker through the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Where data is insufficient, raise a portal message listing the missing items
State that indicative pricing cannot proceed until the items are supplied
Log the request date so the chase can be tracked
Done when the gap list has been sent and logged
verify: Portal message content matches the gap note on the record
Pass when every insufficient assessment has a matching outbound gap request

generic.Defined scope/population: The indicative rating run for this insured across every section to be indicated

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every indication record references an existing rating run ID with a matching band

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Range taken from the tool output with minimum premium tested and width justified
generic.Evidence location: Earnix rating run output linked from the indication record run ID field

steps.title: Key the class code and exposure basis into Earnix Rating and Pricing
sop: Open a new indicative rating run for the line of business in Earnix
Enter the confirmed class code and the exposure basis for each section
Set the requested inception date so the correct rate table version applies
Done when all rating inputs are keyed and the run is ready to execute
verify: Keyed class code matches the code recorded on the indication record
Pass when inputs in Earnix reconcile to the captured risk data

steps.title: Execute the indicative rating run in Earnix Rating and Pricing
sop: Run the indicative rating calculation and wait for a completed status
Check the run completed without validation errors or warnings
Note the generated rating run ID and the engine version used
Done when a completed indicative run with a run ID exists
verify: Run status shows completed with no outstanding validation errors
Pass when a run ID has been generated for a clean completed run

steps.title: Take the low and high band directly from the Earnix output
sop: Read the low and high indicative premium values from the run output
Copy the values rather than estimating or rounding them by hand
Record which output fields the band values were taken from
Done when the band is captured directly from tool output
verify: Captured band values match the run output figures exactly
Pass when no band value has been manually typed or adjusted

steps.title: Test the minimum premium for the line against the low end of the range
sop: Look up the filed minimum premium for the line and class
Compare the low end of the indicative range to that minimum
Raise the low end to the minimum premium where the range falls below it
Done when the low end sits at or above the minimum premium
verify: Low end of the range is greater than or equal to the line minimum premium
Pass when no indicated range starts below the filed minimum

steps.title: Justify the width of the range against data uncertainty on the file
sop: Assess how far the supplied data falls short of full submission quality
Set the band width to reflect that uncertainty rather than a default spread
Write a short note naming the uncertainty drivers behind the width
Done when the range width is justified in a note on the file
verify: Note names specific data gaps driving the chosen band width
Pass when the width justification is present and references the actual data gaps

steps.title: Record the rating run ID and band on the indication record in the workstation
sop: Enter the low and high band into the indication record premium fields
Enter the Earnix rating run ID into the run reference field
Attach the run output document to the indication record
Done when band, run ID and output are stored on the indication record
verify: Run ID on the record resolves to an existing Earnix run
Pass when the recorded band equals the band in the referenced run output

steps.title: Review the appetite outcome recorded on the indication record in the workstation
sop: Open the indication record and read the recorded appetite outcome
Confirm the class, geography and limit tested are all recorded
Confirm the indicative range and its rating run ID are present
Done when the appetite outcome and pricing basis are confirmed
verify: Appetite outcome field is populated with in, out or referral
Pass when the recorded outcome is supported by a tested class and limit

steps.title: Screen the insured against the prohibited class and no-write lists
sop: Open the current prohibited class and no-write lists for the line
Screen the insured name and class code against both lists
Record the screening date and result on the indication record
Done when the screening result is recorded on the record
verify: Screening result is recorded with the date of the check
Pass when no go is issued on any insured or class appearing on either list

steps.title: Set the go or no-go flag on the indication record
sop: Select go or no-go on the indication record decision field
Ensure the decision is consistent with the appetite outcome and screening result
Save the record and confirm the flag persists
Done when the go/no-go flag is set and saved
verify: Decision flag is populated and consistent with the appetite outcome
Pass when the saved flag matches the underwriting decision taken

steps.title: Select the appetite or exposure reason code on any no-go
sop: Where the decision is no-go, open the controlled reason code list
Select the appetite or exposure code that best describes the declinature
Add a short free-text note only to supplement the selected code
Done when every no-go carries a reason code from the controlled list
verify: Reason code is a value from the controlled list, not free text
Pass when no no-go decision is left without a coded reason

steps.title: List the further information needed to firm up any go
sop: Where the decision is go, identify the data still missing for a formal quote
List survey, loss run, exposure schedule or wording items required
Record the list on the indication record so it can be chased
Done when a go decision carries a named further information list
verify: Further information list is present on every go decision
Pass when the listed items are specific enough for the broker to act on

steps.title: Issue the recommendation through the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Draft the outbound message stating the go or no-go position clearly
State that the indication remains subject to full submission and formal underwriting
Send through the broker portal and attach the message to the indication record
Done when the recommendation is visible to the broker and logged
verify: Outbound message states the subject to full submission wording
Pass when the issued message matches the flag and reason code on the record

generic.Defined scope/population: All coverage and terms assumptions underpinning this indication across every section
generic.In-scope period: Assumptions as at the indication issue date and valid to the indication expiry
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assumed limits, sub-limits, deductibles, wording family and key exclusions all stated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assumed section list matches the sections priced in the indicative rating run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assumptions note attached to the indication record with underwriter name and date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assumptions that later prove wrong are logged and the indication reissued or withdrawn
generic.Test population: All indications issued in the review month with an attached assumptions note
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every issued indication has an assumptions note dated on or before its issue date

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Note states limits, wording family, key exclusions and the unverified loss data caveat
generic.Evidence location: Assumptions note stored in OpenText Document Mgmt and linked to the indication record

steps.title: List assumed limits, sub-limits and deductibles per section in the workstation
sop: List each section that was priced in the indicative rating run
State the assumed limit, sub-limit and deductible for each section
Mark any figure that was assumed rather than supplied by the broker
Done when every priced section has stated assumed terms
verify: Section list matches the sections in the indicative rating run
Pass when no priced section is missing an assumed limit and deductible

steps.title: Name the assumed policy wording or form family
sop: Identify the wording family the indicative price was built on
Record the form family name and edition assumption
Note that a different requested wording would change the indication
Done when the assumed wording family is named in the note
verify: Named wording family exists in the current approved form library
Pass when the assumed wording is named and traceable to the form library

steps.title: State the assumed key exclusions in the note
sop: List the key exclusions assumed such as flood, cyber and communicable disease
State that removal of any listed exclusion would require re-rating
Record any exclusion the broker has asked to be removed as not yet priced
Done when all assumed key exclusions are listed
verify: Exclusion list covers the standard key exclusions for the line
Pass when each assumed exclusion is stated explicitly rather than implied

steps.title: Record the unverified loss experience assumption explicitly
sop: State that loss experience is taken as advised by the broker and unverified
Note the years of loss data relied on and their source
State that verified loss runs may change the indication
Done when the unverified loss data assumption is written in the note
verify: Note contains an explicit unverified loss experience statement
Pass when the loss data source and years relied on are both named

steps.title: Store the assumptions note in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Save the completed assumptions note as a document in OpenText
Index it by insured name, broker and indication reference
Apply the document type Underwriting assumptions note
Done when the note is stored and indexed in OpenText
verify: Document is retrievable in OpenText by the indication reference
Pass when the stored note is indexed under the correct indication reference

steps.title: Attach the note to the indication record with underwriter name and date
sop: Link the stored OpenText document to the indication record
Record the authoring underwriter name and the note date on the record
Confirm the note date is on or before the indication issue date
Done when the dated and attributed note is linked to the record
verify: Note date is on or before the indication issue date
Pass when the attached note carries an underwriter name and a valid date

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior carrier and credit reports ordered for the named insured on this indication

steps.title: Select the permissible purpose code before ordering any report
sop: Determine the permissible purpose applicable to this underwriting inquiry
Select the purpose code in Credit Bureau and Data Services before submitting
Confirm the insured consent position where consent is required

steps.title: Order the prior carrier history report from LexisNexis Risk

Order the prior carrier history covering lapses and cancellations

steps.title: Read the prior carrier history for lapses and cancellations

Summarise the carrier history findings on the risk summary

steps.title: Capture the credit and financial stability score on the risk summary
sop: Order the commercial credit report from Credit Bureau and Data Services
Capture the credit or financial stability score and its scale
Record any adverse financial event noted in the report
Done when the score and its scale are on the risk summary
verify: Recorded score matches the score on the returned report
Pass when both the score and its scale are recorded on the summary

steps.title: Flag adverse signals for referral rather than pricing them in
sop: Test the findings against the adverse signal referral triggers for the line
Raise a referral where any trigger is met instead of adjusting the price
Record the referral reference on the indication record
Done when every triggered adverse signal has a raised referral
verify: Each triggered adverse signal has a referral reference recorded
Pass when no adverse signal has been absorbed into price without referral

steps.title: Record report references and pull date on the indication record
sop: Enter the LexisNexis and bureau report reference numbers on the record
Enter the pull date for each report
Attach the report copies to the indication record
Done when references, dates and copies are all on the record
verify: Recorded references match the inquiry log on the bureau account
Pass when every report on the record has a reference and a pull date

steps.title: Retrieve the inbound broker request from the Broker and Agent Portal
sop: Open the broker portal inbound queue and select the new request

Download any attachments provided with the request
Done when the request and its attachments have been retrieved

verify: Producer code matches a valid code on the CRM broker master

steps.title: Record the requested inception date and any target premium
sop: Enter the requested inception date stated by the broker
Record any target premium or budget figure the broker has named
Note the requested policy term where it differs from twelve months
Done when inception date and any budget figure are recorded
verify: Inception date on the record matches the date stated in the request
Pass when the requested inception date is populated on the record

steps.title: Mark the request type as Indication in CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics)
sop: Set the request type field to Indication rather than Full submission
Confirm the workflow routes to the indication queue and not to new business intake
Save the record and confirm the type persists
Done when the request type reads Indication
verify: Request type field displays Indication after save

steps.title: Link the request to an existing account or create a new account record
sop: Search CRM for an existing account for the insured legal name
Link the request to the matched account where one exists
Create a new account record where no match is found and link it
Done when the request is linked to exactly one account record
verify: Request shows a single linked account and no duplicate account created

steps.title: Send the acknowledgement to the broker within the service standard
sop: Send an acknowledgement naming the handling underwriter and the request reference
Send within the published service standard for indication requests
Log the acknowledgement as an activity on the CRM opportunity
Done when the acknowledgement is sent and logged
verify: Elapsed time from receipt to acknowledgement is within the service standard
Pass when every logged request carries a logged acknowledgement in standard

sop: Review the logged request for completeness of the captured fields

sop: Retrieve the indication document that was issued to the broker
